lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 vertical white stripes are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is irregular, with more frequent intervals on the anterior torso and wider gaps toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A distinct Y-shaped bifurcation is located in the upper mid-torso region, where a primary vertical line splits into two distinct segments moving ventrally.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several stripes on the lower mid-torso terminate as abbreviated segments before reaching the ventral fringe hair; additional dashed segments are visible near the spine transition.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of approximately 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch, positioned below the primary stripe terminus.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the lower hind limb align to form a semi-linear diagonal cluster moving from the posterior thigh toward the hock.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a tight spiral at the base, transitioning into a broad lyrate curve with the distal segments tapering outward and upward from the skull midline.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.8 times the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-white tips represent approximately 15% of the total longitudinal length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white chevron is visible between the eyes, supplemented by distinct white spots on the lateral muzzle and a white patch at the throat.
